name: End-of-Year Delinquent Meal Debt Referral
description: Unrecovered school meal debt remaining at year end is referred to the Director of Business Services for action (treated as bad debt repaid from non-federal funds).
deadline: at the end of each school year
quote: After taking reasonable steps to collect delinquent school meal debt, which shall include at least two written correspondences to the student’s parent/guardian, unrecovered/delinquent debt at the end of each school year shall be referred to the Director of Business Services for appropriate action.
